USB firmware flasherInstall v0.1.4 or choose a .bin

Connect the ESP32 to your computer

  1. Stop the diagnostic and let the roaster cool. Disconnect BLE and unplug the ESP32 from the roaster.
  2. Hold BOOT while connecting the ESP32’s USB-C port to your computer with a data cable. Release BOOT.
  3. Choose the firmware below, connect to the ESP32-S3 serial port, then select Install in the installer dialog.

After installation, close the installer, unplug the computer cable, and reconnect the ESP32 to the roaster. Use BLE for diagnostics. An unavailable USB console after flashing this firmware is expected.

For this 4 MB ESP32-S3 Zero. Use a complete merged image written at 0x0; application-only binaries need a different installation method. Selected files stay in your browser.

Use desktop Chrome or Edge for USB installation.Open the HTTPS website or use localhost for USB installation.

Commands and line activity do not prove the board acted on them. Temperature uses the original SkyCommand conversion.

Guided bench test

60% / 55°C
  1. Capture baseline
  2. Verify exhaust fan
  3. Verify cooling fan
  4. Verify drum + exhaust
  5. Confirm readiness and start heat
  6. Heat at 60% to 55°C
  7. Cool below 45°C

Complete the fan and drum checks before starting heat.

Heat stops on stale telemetry, lost BLE heartbeat, failed checks, or a 180-second limit. If commands are ignored, cut power manually. 55°C is a heater-off threshold; temperature can overshoot.

Protocol comparison

MeasurementOriginal baselineRoaster → ESP32Command line
No capture yet. Both receive pins are monitored; command-line traffic needs a connected controller or an active test.

Changing the transmit profile never follows automatically from incoming timing. Listen-only capture with the original controller requires a suitable breakout. Capture window: pulses below 9.5 ms, approximately 96 symbols per block; this is not a replacement for an oscilloscope.
